answer_text: The KB lists these conditions that can cause an HA Not Ready (Socket HA Status Not Ready) state: one of the HA pair member sockets is offline; HA status not ready due to Keepalive; and HA status not ready due to Compatible Version. The KB does not specify the exact timing for when HA Ready is generated after Not Ready; it only points to the XOps Network Playbook as the remediation path to resolve Not Ready and restore HA functionality.
